headline: Clinton order sets an open enrollment period for people in the Foreign Service and CIA retirement and disability systems.
what_it_does: This executive order creates an open enrollment season for people covered by two special federal retirement programs: the Foreign Service Retirement and Disability System and the Central Intelligence Agency Retirement and Disability System. During an open enrollment season, eligible people get a limited window to make choices about their retirement coverage. The title does not say exactly what choices are offered or how long the window lasts.

who_it_affects.group: Foreign Service employees in the Foreign Service Retirement and Disability System
who_it_affects.how: They get a set period of time to make an enrollment choice about their retirement coverage.

who_it_affects.group: CIA employees in the Central Intelligence Agency Retirement and Disability System
who_it_affects.how: They get a set period of time to make an enrollment choice about their retirement coverage.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 2, 1998; the dates of the enrollment window are not stated in the title.
